newsitem.title: UK: Medeva posts surge in underlying profit.
newsitem.headline: Medeva posts surge in underlying profit.

text.p: Drugs group Medeva Plc said on Wednesday that underlying pre-tax profit rose by 31 percent last year to 103.5 million pounds ($166.3 million) from 79 million, just beating analysts' forecasts of between 99 and 103 million.
However the headline pre-tax profit figure was affected by an expected 65 million pound charge related to last year's acquisition of businesses in the U.S.
The dividend rose 20 percent to 4.8 pence per share from 4.0 pence.
Medeva also announced its intention to switch its U.S. American Depositary Receipt (ADR) listing to the New York Stock Exchange from the American Stock Exchange.
Medeva said the move reflected its growing strength in the U.S. after last year's acquisition of the U.S. assets of Fisons from Rhone Poulenc Rorer Inc for $370 million.
Strong growth by the former Fisons products fueled a 30 percent rise in total sales to 332 million pounds. ($ = 0.622 British Pounds)
